- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build cases with the original and compare my export.

usage:
  case.py build NAME            # cases/NAME.txt (a script) -> cases/NAME.bimcraft, cases/NAME.ifc (original)
  case.py cmp NAME [-n LINES]   # convert cases/NAME.bimcraft with mine and the original; diff normalised
  case.py all                   # cmp every case, print SAME/DIFF per case
"""
import os, re, subprocess, sys, difflib, glob, tempfile, shutil
ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = os.environ.get('MINE', '/workspace/.claude/worktrees/agent-a7aa74e0622ce519f/target/release/bimcraft-cli')
D = os.environ.get('CASES', '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/cases')

def norm(s):
    s = re.sub(r"'\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d'", "'<TIMESTAMP>'", s)
    gm = {}
    def grep(mo):
        g = mo.group(1)
        if g not in gm: gm[g] = 'GID-%d' % (len(gm)+1)
        return "('" + gm[g] + "'"
    s = re.sub(r"\('([0-9A-Za-z_$]{22})'", grep, s)
    return s

def build(name):
    txt = os.path.join(D, name + '.txt')
    bim = os.path.join(D, name + '.bimcraft')
    ifc = os.path.join(D, name + '.ifc')
    args = [ORIG, 'run']
    if open(txt).read().strip():
        args += ['--script', txt]
    args += ['--save', bim, '--save', ifc]
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print('BUILD FAILED', name, p.stderr.strip()[:2000])
        return False
    return True

def export(exe, bim):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='ifcx')
    out = os.path.join(d, 'out.ifc')
    p = subprocess.run([exe, 'convert', bim, out], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    s = open(out, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read() if os.path.exists(out) else ''
    shutil.rmtree(d)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr, s

def cmp(name, n=40, quiet=False):
    bim = os.path.join(D, name + '.bimcraft')
    if not os.path.exists(bim):
        if not build(name): return False
    a = export(ORIG, bim)
    b = export(MINE, bim)
    x = norm(a[3]).splitlines()
    y = norm(b[3]).splitlines()
    ok = x == y and a[0] == b[0]
    if not ok and not quiet:
        if a[0] != b[0] or a[2] != b[2]:
            print('exit/stderr: orig', a[0], a[2].strip()[:300], '| mine', b[0], b[2].strip()[:300])
        for l in list(difflib.unified_diff(x, y, 'orig', 'mine', lineterm='', n=1))[:n]:
            print(l[:400])
    return ok

def asset_check(name, path, n=30):
    """Does the original's export of cases/NAME equal the asset file (normalised)?"""
    bim = os.path.join(D, name + '.bimcraft')
    if not build(name): return False
    a = export(ORIG, bim)
    x = norm(a[3]).splitlines()
    y = open(path).read().splitlines()
    if x == y:
        print(name, 'ORIG==ASSET')
        return True
    for l in list(difflib.unified_diff(y, x, 'asset', 'orig', lineterm='', n=1))[:n]:
        print(l[:400])
    print(name, 'ORIG!=ASSET')
    return False

if __name__ == '__main__':
    a = sys.argv[1:]
    if a[0] == 'asset':
        asset_check(a[1], a[2], int(a[3]) if len(a) > 3 else 30)
    elif a[0] == 'build':
        for nm in a[1:]: build(nm)
    elif a[0] == 'cmp':
        n = 40
        if '-n' in a:
            i = a.index('-n'); n = int(a[i+1]); del a[i:i+2]
        for nm in a[1:]:
            r = cmp(nm, n)
            print(nm, 'SAME' if r else 'DIFF')
    elif a[0] == 'all':
        names = sorted(os.path.basename(f)[:-4] for f in glob.glob(D + '/*.txt'))
        if len(a) > 1: names = [x for x in names if re.search(a[1], x)]
        same = 0
        for nm in names:
            r = cmp(nm, quiet=True)
            same += r
            print('%-30s %s' % (nm, 'SAME' if r else 'DIFF'))
        print(same, '/', len(names))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Grid tie-breaking probe: a lattice of shape points with distinct heights; print the diagonal
chosen in each lattice cell."""
import json, subprocess, sys, re
name = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'q13'
sx = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 2000
sy = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 2000
W, H = 8000, 6000
pts = []
z = -10
lattice = []
for x in range(0, W + 1, sx):
    for y in range(0, H + 1, sy):
        lattice.append((x, y))
        if (x, y) in [(0, 0), (W, 0), (W, H), (0, H)]:
            continue
        pts.append({"at": [x, y], "z": z})
        z -= 7
cmds = ['floor {"boundary": [[0,0],[%d,0],[%d,%d],[0,%d]]}' % (W, W, H, H),
        'modify ' + json.dumps({"id": 100002, "shape": {"points": pts}})]
out = subprocess.run(['python3', '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/tools/probe.py', name] + cmds, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
coords = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'p(\d+) #\d+ \(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', out):
    coords[int(m.group(1))] = (float(m.group(2)), float(m.group(3)))
edges = set()
for line in out.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('  F') and '|' not in line:
        ids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'p(\d+)', line)]
        if len(ids) == 3:
            for i in range(3):
                a, b = coords[ids[i]], coords[ids[(i + 1) % 3]]
                edges.add((min(a, b), max(a, b)))
rows = []
for y in range(H - sy, -1, -sy):
    row = ''
    for x in range(0, W, sx):
        d1 = ((float(x), float(y)), (float(x + sx), float(y + sy)))  # '/'
        d2 = ((float(x), float(y + sy)), (float(x + sx), float(y)))  # '\'
        d2 = (min(d2), max(d2))
        row += '/' if d1 in edges else ('\\' if d2 in edges else '?')
    rows.append(row)
print('\n'.join(rows))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""How a wall attached at its top and its base is cut: options compared with the original
(case W5: a hip roof over a shaped floor, a diagonal wall)."""
import math, sys

def fmt(v):
    v = v + 0.0
    return ('%.6f' % v).rstrip('0')

def half_ring(ring, a, d, keep_left):
    n = len(ring)
    out = []
    sides = [d[0] * (p[1] - a[1]) - d[1] * (p[0] - a[0]) for p in ring]
    inside = (lambda v: v >= 0.0) if keep_left else (lambda v: v <= 0.0)
    for i in range(n):
        si = (i - 1) % n
        s, e = ring[si], ring[i]
        ss, se = sides[si], sides[i]
        def cut():
            t = se / (se - ss)
            return (e[0] + (s[0] - e[0]) * t, e[1] + (s[1] - e[1]) * t)
        if inside(se):
            if not inside(ss):
                out.append(cut())
            out.append(e)
        elif inside(ss):
            out.append(cut())
    return out

def area(r):
    return sum(r[i][0] * r[(i + 1) % len(r)][1] - r[i][1] * r[(i + 1) % len(r)][0] for i in range(len(r))) / 2

def ok(r):
    return len(r) >= 3 and abs(area(r)) > 1e-6

def cut_by_pieces(rings, pieces, tag):
    """rings: list of (ring, info); returns parts [(ring, info + (piece,))] and leftovers"""
    parts = []
    left = list(rings)
    for i, piece in enumerate(pieces):
        nxt = []
        for r, info in left:
            rest = r
            m = len(piece)
            for k in range(m):
                a = piece[k]
                b = piece[(k + 1) % m]
                d = (b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1])
                out = half_ring(rest, a, d, False)
                inn = half_ring(rest, a, d, True)
                if ok(out):
                    nxt.append((out, info))
                rest = inn
                if not ok(rest):
                    break
            if ok(rest):
                parts.append((rest, info + ((tag, i),)))
        left = nxt
    parts.extend((r, info + ((tag, None),)) for r, info in left)
    return parts

roof = [[(0, 0), (8000, 0), (5000, 3000), (3000, 3000)], [(8000, 0), (8000, 6000), (5000, 3000)],
        [(8000, 6000), (0, 6000), (3000, 3000), (5000, 3000)], [(0, 6000), (0, 0), (3000, 3000)]]
floor = [[(0, 0), (4000, 3000), (0, 6000)], [(0, 0), (8000, 0), (4000, 3000)], [(0, 6000), (4000, 3000), (8000, 6000)],
         [(4000, 3000), (8000, 0), (8000, 6000)]]
s, e = (1000.0, 1000.0), (7000.0, 5000.0)
dx, dy = e[0] - s[0], e[1] - s[1]
l = math.hypot(dx, dy)
r = 1.0 / l
d = (dx * r, dy * r)
n = (-d[1], d[0])
def off(p, k):
    return (p[0] + n[0] * k, p[1] + n[1] * k)
outline = [off(e, -100), off(e, 100), off(s, 100), off(s, -100)]
def local(p):
    q = (p[0] - s[0], p[1] - s[1])
    return (q[0] * d[0] + q[1] * d[1], q[0] * n[0] + q[1] * n[1])
ORIG = """1805.551275,-100. 3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3455.551275,100. 500.,100. -0.,-0. -0.,-100.
3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3570.257158,100. 3455.551275,100.
500.,100. 500.,100. -0.,100. 0.,0.
3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 1805.551275,-100. 3640.845393,-100.
4318.737242,39.621443 5405.551275,100. 4306.661531,100.
3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 4318.737242,39.621443 4306.661531,100. 3570.257158,100.
3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3640.845393,-100. 3755.551275,-100.
6711.102551,-100. 7211.102551,-100. 7211.102551,0.
4318.737242,39.621443 4346.661531,-100. 6711.102551,-100. 7211.102551,0. 7211.102551,100. 5405.551275,100.
4318.737242,39.621443 3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3605.551275,0. 3755.551275,-100. 4346.661531,-100.""".split('\n')

def show(name, parts):
    lines = [' '.join('%s,%s' % (fmt(local(p)[0]), fmt(local(p)[1])) for p in r) for r, _ in parts]
    sc = sum(1 for a, b in zip(lines, ORIG) if a == b)
    print(name, sc, '/', len(ORIG), 'parts', len(lines))
    for (l, (_, info)), o in zip(zip(lines, parts), ORIG + [''] * 20):
        print(('   ' if l == o else '!! ') + l, info)

# A: tops, then each part by the bases

# C: tops, then all their parts together by the bases

show('C', C)

for w, poly in zip(walls, polys):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Right railings of one-run stairs at angle 90 from (x, 0) for several x: the sign of the
start point's y."""
import json, re, subprocess, sys
xs = [0, 1, 10, 100, 450, 500, 1000, 3000, 6000, 10000, -1000, -6000]
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
angle = float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 90
cmds = []
for k, x in enumerate(xs):
    cmds.append('stair ' + json.dumps({"start": [x, 20000 * k], "angle": angle, "height": 700, "width": 1000}))
    cmds.append('railing ' + json.dumps({"host": 100002 + 2 * k, "side": "right"}))
open(D + '/rs.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/rs.txt', '--save', D + '/rs.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr)
s = open(D + '/rs.ifc').read()
axes = re.findall(r"IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION\(#6,'Axis','Curve3D',\(#(\d+)\)\)", s)
ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
for x, a in zip(xs, axes):
    pts = re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[int(a)])
    print(x, ents[int(pts[0])])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replicate the railing path of a 180-turn stair (right side) in floating point and print the
segment lengths and their running sum."""
import math

def add(a, b): return (a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1])
def sub(a, b): return (a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])
def mul(a, k): return (a[0] * k, a[1] * k)
def perp(a): return (-a[1], a[0])
def cross(a, b): return a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]
def norm(a):
    l = math.sqrt(a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1])
    r = 1.0 / l
    return (a[0] * r, a[1] * r)
def length(a): return math.sqrt(a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1])
def line_cross(a, d, b, e):
    den = cross(d, e)
    t = cross(sub(b, a), e) / den
    return add(a, mul(d, t))

start = (36000.0, 0.0)
r = math.radians(90.0)
d = (math.cos(r), math.sin(r))
w = 1000.0
L = 560.0
end = add(start, mul(d, L))
n = perp(d)
p2 = add(end, mul(n, w))
d2 = mul(d, -1.0)
end2 = add(p2, mul(d2, L))
s = -1.0
off = w / 2 - 50
u = norm(sub(end, start)); nu1 = perp(u)
a = add(start, mul(nu1, s * off)); b = add(end, mul(nu1, s * off))
u2 = norm(sub(end2, p2)); nu2 = perp(u2)
na = add(p2, mul(nu2, s * off)); nb = add(end2, mul(nu2, s * off))
fa = add(end, mul(u, w - 50))
c1 = line_cross(b, u, fa, nu1)
c2 = line_cross(fa, nu1, na, u2)
pts = [a, b, c1, c2, na, nb]
tot = 0.0
for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
    l = length(sub(pts[i + 1], pts[i]))
    tot += l
    print(repr(pts[i]), '->', repr(pts[i + 1]), repr(l), repr(tot))

"""Try csg.js variants on the inspection box (a cylinder less a smaller one) against the
original's output."""
import itertools, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/csg')
import csg

opts = list(itertools.product([True, False], [False, True], ['top_bottom', 'bottom_top', 'sides_first'], ['rev', 'rev0']))
orig_pts, orig_tris = csg.load_orig('/tmp/ifc-export-agent/csg/inspection.txt')
for pr, ur, co, br in opts:
    csg.OPT['plane_recompute'] = pr
    csg.OPT['unit_recip'] = ur
    a = csg.prism_polys(csg.circle(0, 0, 125), -300.0, 0.0, cap_order=co, bottom_rev=br)
    b = csg.prism_polys(csg.circle(0, 0, 105), -280.0, 0.0, cap_order=co, bottom_rev=br)
    res = csg.subtract(a, b)
    pts, tris = csg.triangulate(res)
    fp = [tuple(csg.fmt(c) for c in (p.x, p.y, p.z)) for p in pts]
    same_pts = sum(1 for x, y in zip(fp, orig_pts) if x == y)
    same_tris = sum(1 for x, y in zip(tris, orig_tris) if x == y)
    print(pr, ur, co, br, 'points', len(pts), 'vs', len(orig_pts), 'first-equal', same_pts, 'tris', len(tris), 'vs', len(orig_tris), 'equal', same_tris)
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        print(fp[:6])
        print(orig_pts[:6])

"""Compare a triangulated face set (by its point list entity number) in two IFC files: the
first differing triangle, as coordinates."""
import re, sys
def load(path, ent):
    s = open(path).read()
    m = re.search(r'^#%d=IFCCARTESIANPOINTLIST3D\(\((.*)\)\);$' % ent, s, re.M)
    pts = re.findall(r'\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', m.group(1))
    m2 = re.search(r'^#\d+=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET\(#%d,\$,\.T\.,\((.*)\),\$\);$' % ent, s, re.M)
    tris = [tuple(int(x) - 1 for x in t) for t in re.findall(r'\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+)\)', m2.group(1))]
    return pts, tris
a = load(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[3]))
b = load(sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]))

        for j in range(max(0, k - 3), min(k + 6, len(a[1]), len(b[1]))):

            print('  B', j, [b[0][i] for i in b[1][j]])

else:

import csg

pts, tris = triangulate(res, kf)
print(len(pts), len(tris))
for i in (24, 42):

"""For each IFC asset and the case reconstructing it: does the original's export of the case

import os, re, subprocess, sys

    ('a_attached', 'test_ifc_export/attached.ifc'),

    ('a_phased_kinds', 'test_ifc_export/phased_kinds.ifc'),
    ('a_phasing', 'test_ifc_export/phasing.ifc'),
    ('a_roofs', 'test_ifc_export/roofs.ifc'),
    ('a_shaped', 'test_ifc_export/shaped.ifc'),
    ('a_slabs', 'test_ifc_export/slabs.ifc'),
    ('a_structure', 'test_ifc_export/structure.ifc'),
    ('a_walls', 'test_ifc_export/walls.ifc'),
    ('a_msr', 'test_model_geometry/masses_stairs_rooms.ifc'),

    ('a_mg_walls', 'test_model_geometry/walls.ifc'),
    ('a_mepruns', 'test_mep_runs/mep.ifc'),
    ('a_struct2', 'test_structure_elements/structure.ifc'),
    ('a_rebar', 'test_structure_reinforce/rebar.ifc'),
]

def canon(lines):
    # the storeys' aggregation and containments in a fixed order
    out = []
    for l in lines:
        m = re.match(r"(#\d+=IFCRELAGGREGATES\('GID-\d+',\$,\$,\$,#20,\()(.*)(\)\);)", l)
        if m:
            l = m.group(1) + ','.join(sorted(m.group(2).split(','))) + m.group(3)
        out.append(l)
    return out

for case, asset in PAIRS:
    bim = os.path.join(C.D, case + '.bimcraft')
    if not os.path.exists(bim):
        C.build(case)
    a = C.export(C.ORIG, bim)
    b = C.export(C.MINE, bim)
    orig = C.norm(a[3]).splitlines()
    mine = C.norm(b[3]).splitlines()
    want = open('/workspace/assets/' + asset).read().splitlines()
    same_asset = orig == want
    if not same_asset:
        # storeys may come in either order: compare ignoring the order of those lines
        same_asset = sorted(canon(orig)) == sorted(canon(want)) and len(orig) == len(want)
        tag = 'asset~' if same_asset else 'ASSET!'
    else:
        tag = 'asset='
    print('%-16s %-45s %s mine=%s' % (case, asset, tag, 'SAME' if mine == orig else 'DIFF'))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Angle formulas for revolve steps: the original has cos >= 0 at 270 (end of 0..270 in 24
steps), sin < 0 at 180 (step 16 of a full turn in 32), sin >= 0 at 180 when it is the start."""
import math
def fmt(v):
    v = v + 0.0
    return ('%.6f' % v).rstrip('0')
cases = [('270 end', 0.0, 270.0, 24, 24, 'cos', '>=0'), ('180 mid', 0.0, 360.0, 32, 16, 'sin', '<0'), ('180 start', 180.0, 360.0, 16, 0, 'sin', '>=0'),
         ('270 mid full', 0.0, 360.0, 32, 24, 'cos', '>=0?'), ('90 mid full', 0.0, 360.0, 32, 8, 'cos', '?')]
forms = {
    'deg': lambda f, t, n, j: math.radians(f + (t - f) * j / n),
    'deg_step': lambda f, t, n, j: math.radians(f + j * ((t - f) / n)),
    'rad_step': lambda f, t, n, j: math.radians(f) + j * (math.radians(t - f) / n),
    'rad_step2': lambda f, t, n, j: math.radians(f) + j * ((math.radians(t) - math.radians(f)) / n),
    'rad_frac': lambda f, t, n, j: math.radians(f) + math.radians(t - f) * (j / n),
    'lerp': lambda f, t, n, j: math.radians(f) * (1 - j / n) + math.radians(t) * (j / n),
}
for name, fn in forms.items():
    out = []
    for label, f, t, n, j, which, want in cases:
        th = fn(f, t, n, j)
        v = math.cos(th) if which == 'cos' else math.sin(th)
        out.append('%s:%s=%.3g(%s)' % (label, which, v, want))
    print(name, ' | '.join(out))

"""All differing triangles of a face set between two files (as coordinates)."""
import re, sys
def load(path, ent):
    s = open(path).read()
    m = re.search(r'^#%d=IFCCARTESIANPOINTLIST3D\(\((.*)\)\);$' % ent, s, re.M)
    pts = re.findall(r'\(([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+),([-\d.]+)\)', m.group(1))
    m2 = re.search(r'^#\d+=IFCTRIANGULATEDFACESET\(#%d,\$,\.T\.,\((.*)\),\$\);$' % ent, s, re.M)
    tris = [tuple(int(x) - 1 for x in t) for t in re.findall(r'\((\d+),(\d+),(\d+)\)', m2.group(1))]
    return pts, tris
a = load(sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[3]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Rotated hip roofs: the original's underside heights at each face's eave corners (their
signs), against formulas for the height of a face's plane."""
import math, re, sys
s = open('/tmp/ifc-export-agent/cases/rf_rot.ifc').read()
ents = {int(m.group(1)): (m.group(2), m.group(3)) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=(\w+)\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
def refs(t): return [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'#(\d+)', t)]
orig = []
for k, (c, a) in sorted(ents.items()):
    if c == 'IFCFACETEDBREP':
        shell = refs(a)[0]
        faces = refs(ents[shell][1])
        # the bottom face is written reversed: its last two corners are the eave's start and end... take the points by entity order
        f0 = refs(ents[faces[0]][1])[0]
        loop = refs(ents[f0][1])[0]
        ids = sorted(refs(ents[loop][1]))
        p0 = ents[ids[0]][1]; p1 = ents[ids[1]][1]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Arc walls: the original's axis polyline first and last points (signs), against hypotheses."""
import json, math, re, subprocess, sys
walls = [
    ((8000, 0), (8000, 6000), -90),
    ((0, 0), (6000, 0), 90),
    ((0, 0), (6000, 0), -90),
    ((1000, 1000), (5000, 4000), 60),
    ((1000, 1000), (5000, 4000), -60),
    ((0, 0), (0, 5000), 180),
    ((0, 0), (3000, 3000), 45),
    ((0, 0), (-3000, 2000), -120),
    ((500, 700), (4500, -2300), 30),
    ((-2000, 0), (2000, 0), 270),
    ((20000, 0), (26000, 3000), 60),
    ((26000, 3000), (30000, 0), -45),
    ((12000, 0), (18000, 0), 90),
]
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
cmds = []
for k, (a, b, arc) in enumerate(walls):
    dy = 30000 * k
    cmds.append('wall ' + json.dumps({"points": [[a[0], a[1] + dy], [b[0], b[1] + dy]], "arc": arc}))
open(D + '/arcax.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/arcax.txt', '--save', D + '/arcax.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr); sys.exit(1)
s = open(D + '/arcax.ifc').read()
ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
axes = re.findall(r"IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION\(#6,'Axis','Curve2D',\(#(\d+)\)\)", s)
ORIG = []
for a in axes:
    ids = re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[int(a)])
    ORIG.append((ents[int(ids[0])], ents[int(ids[-1])]))
def fmt(v):
    v = v + 0.0
    return ('%.6f' % v).rstrip('0')
def norm(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0] ** 2 + v[1] ** 2); r = 1.0 / l
    return (v[0] * r, v[1] * r)
def perp(v): return (-v[1], v[0])
def add(a, b): return (a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1])
def sub(a, b): return (a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])
def mul(a, k): return (a[0] * k, a[1] * k)
def dot(a, b): return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]
def rot(v, ang):
    s, c = math.sin(ang), math.cos(ang)
    return (v[0] * c - v[1] * s, v[0] * s + v[1] * c)
def segs(radius, sweep):
    step = 2.0 * math.acos(1.0 - 1.0 / abs(radius))
    return max(1, math.ceil(abs(sweep) / step))
def run(hc, start, end, arc):
    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    chord = sub(end, start)
    c = math.sqrt(chord[0] ** 2 + chord[1] ** 2)
    d = norm(chord)
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    t = rot(d, -sweep / 2.0)
    if hc == 'C1':
        n = perp(t)
        centre = add(start, mul(n, R)) if sweep > 0 else sub(start, mul(n, R))
    elif hc == 'C2':
        m = add(start, mul(chord, 0.5))
        h = R * math.cos(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h)) if sweep > 0 else sub(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    elif hc == 'C3':
        m = mul(add(start, end), 0.5)
        h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    elif hc == 'C4':
        m = add(start, mul(chord, 0.5))
        h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    a0 = math.atan2(start[1] - centre[1], start[0] - centre[0])
    dd = (-math.sin(a0), math.cos(a0)) if sweep > 0 else (math.sin(a0), -math.cos(a0))
    nn = perp(dd)
    k = segs(R, sweep)
    p0 = add(centre, mul((math.cos(a0), math.sin(a0)), R))
    a1 = a0 + sweep
    p1 = add(centre, mul((math.cos(a1), math.sin(a1)), R))
    loc = lambda p: (dot(sub(p, start), dd), dot(sub(p, start), nn))
    l0, l1 = loc(p0), loc(p1)
    return ('(%s,%s)' % (fmt(l0[0]), fmt(l0[1])), '(%s,%s)' % (fmt(l1[0]), fmt(l1[1])))
for hc in ['C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4']:
    res = []
    for kk, (a, b, arc) in enumerate(walls):
        dy = 30000 * kk
        res.append(run(hc, (float(a[0]), float(a[1] + dy)), (float(b[0]), float(b[1] + dy)), arc))
    sc0 = sum(1 for x, y in zip(res, ORIG) if x[0] == y[0])
    sc1 = sum(1 for x, y in zip(res, ORIG) if x[1] == y[1])
    print(hc, 'first', sc0, 'last', sc1, '/', len(walls))
print('orig', ORIG)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Arc walls: the original's axis polyline first and last points (signs), against hypotheses."""
import json, math, re, subprocess, sys
walls = [
    ((8000, 0), (8000, 6000), -90),
    ((0, 0), (6000, 0), 90),
    ((0, 0), (6000, 0), -90),
    ((1000, 1000), (5000, 4000), 60),
    ((1000, 1000), (5000, 4000), -60),
    ((0, 0), (0, 5000), 180),
    ((0, 0), (3000, 3000), 45),
    ((0, 0), (-3000, 2000), -120),
    ((500, 700), (4500, -2300), 30),
    ((-2000, 0), (2000, 0), 270),
    ((20000, 0), (26000, 3000), 60),
    ((26000, 3000), (30000, 0), -45),
    ((12000, 0), (18000, 0), 90),
]
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
cmds = []
for k, (a, b, arc) in enumerate(walls):
    dy = 30000 * k
    cmds.append('wall ' + json.dumps({"points": [[a[0], a[1] + dy], [b[0], b[1] + dy]], "arc": arc}))
open(D + '/arcax.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/arcax.txt', '--save', D + '/arcax.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr); sys.exit(1)
s = open(D + '/arcax.ifc').read()
ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
axes = re.findall(r"IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION\(#6,'Axis','Curve2D',\(#(\d+)\)\)", s)
ORIG = []
for a in axes:
    ids = re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[int(a)])
    ORIG.append((ents[int(ids[0])], ents[int(ids[-1])]))
def fmt(v):
    v = v + 0.0
    return ('%.6f' % v).rstrip('0')
def norm(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0] ** 2 + v[1] ** 2); r = 1.0 / l
    return (v[0] * r, v[1] * r)
def perp(v): return (-v[1], v[0])
def add(a, b): return (a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1])
def sub(a, b): return (a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])
def mul(a, k): return (a[0] * k, a[1] * k)
def dot(a, b): return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]
def rot(v, ang):
    s, c = math.sin(ang), math.cos(ang)
    return (v[0] * c - v[1] * s, v[0] * s + v[1] * c)
def segs(radius, sweep):
    step = 2.0 * math.acos(1.0 - 1.0 / abs(radius))
    return max(1, math.ceil(abs(sweep) / step))
def run(hc, start, end, arc):
    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    chord = sub(end, start)
    c = math.sqrt(chord[0] ** 2 + chord[1] ** 2)
    d = norm(chord)
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    t = rot(d, -sweep / 2.0)
    if hc == 'C1':
        n = perp(t)
        centre = add(start, mul(n, R)) if sweep > 0 else sub(start, mul(n, R))
    elif hc == 'C2':
        m = add(start, mul(chord, 0.5))
        h = R * math.cos(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h)) if sweep > 0 else sub(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    elif hc == 'C3':
        m = mul(add(start, end), 0.5)
        h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    elif hc == 'C4':
        m = add(start, mul(chord, 0.5))
        h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    a0 = math.atan2(start[1] - centre[1], start[0] - centre[0])
    dd = (-math.sin(a0), math.cos(a0)) if sweep > 0 else (math.sin(a0), -math.cos(a0))
    nn = perp(dd)
    k = segs(R, sweep)
    p0 = add(centre, mul((math.cos(a0), math.sin(a0)), R))
    a1 = a0 + sweep
    p1 = add(centre, mul((math.cos(a1), math.sin(a1)), R))
    loc = lambda p: (dot(sub(p, start), dd), dot(sub(p, start), nn))
    l0, l1 = loc(p0), loc(p1)
    return ('(%s,%s)' % (fmt(l0[0]), fmt(l0[1])), '(%s,%s)' % (fmt(l1[0]), fmt(l1[1])))
for hc in ['C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4']:
    res = []
    for kk, (a, b, arc) in enumerate(walls):
        dy = 30000 * kk
        res.append(run(hc, (float(a[0]), float(a[1] + dy)), (float(b[0]), float(b[1] + dy)), arc))
    sc0 = sum(1 for x, y in zip(res, ORIG) if x[0] == y[0])
    sc1 = sum(1 for x, y in zip(res, ORIG) if x[1] == y[1])
    print(hc, 'first', sc0, 'last', sc1, '/', len(walls))
print('orig', ORIG)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Two walls meeting at a node at many angles and thicknesses: the original's end cap of the
first (its outline's end corners in its axes), to find when a side is mitred or squared."""
import json, math, re, subprocess, sys, os
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
types = {"G200": "Generic - 200mm", "E300": "Exterior - 300mm", "I100": "Interior - 100mm"}
combos = [("G200", "G200"), ("E300", "G200"), ("G200", "E300"), ("I100", "E300"), ("E300", "I100")]
angles = [20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75, 90, 105, 120, 135, 150, 160, 170]
cmds = []
meta = []
k = 0
for t1, t2 in combos:
    for ang in angles:
        x0 = 20000 * (k % 10)
        y0 = 20000 * (k // 10)
        r = math.radians(180 - ang)
        p2 = (x0 + 5000 + 4000 * math.cos(r), y0 + 4000 * math.sin(r))
        cmds.append('wall ' + json.dumps({"points": [[x0, y0], [x0 + 5000, y0]], "type": types[t1]}))
        cmds.append('wall ' + json.dumps({"points": [[x0 + 5000, y0], [round(p2[0], 6), round(p2[1], 6)]], "type": types[t2]}))
        meta.append((t1, t2, ang))
        k += 1
open(D + '/mitre.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/mitre.txt', '--save', D + '/mitre.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr); sys.exit(1)
s = open(D + '/mitre.ifc').read()
polys = re.findall(r"IFCARBITRARYCLOSEDPROFILEDEF\(\.AREA\.,\$,#(\d+)\)", s)
ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
for i, (t1, t2, ang) in enumerate(meta):

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final message is returned to you as the tool result; it is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- A previously spawned agent cannot be continued from here; every Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Arc walls: the original's axis polyline first and last points (signs), against hypotheses."""
import json, math, re, subprocess, sys
walls = [
    ((8000, 0), (8000, 6000), -90),
    ((0, 0), (6000, 0), 90),
    ((0, 0), (6000, 0), -90),
    ((1000, 1000), (5000, 4000), 60),
    ((1000, 1000), (5000, 4000), -60),
    ((0, 0), (0, 5000), 180),
    ((0, 0), (3000, 3000), 45),
    ((0, 0), (-3000, 2000), -120),
    ((500, 700), (4500, -2300), 30),
    ((-2000, 0), (2000, 0), 270),
    ((20000, 0), (26000, 3000), 60),
    ((26000, 3000), (30000, 0), -45),
    ((12000, 0), (18000, 0), 90),
]
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
cmds = []
for k, (a, b, arc) in enumerate(walls):
    dy = 30000 * k
    cmds.append('wall ' + json.dumps({"points": [[a[0], a[1] + dy], [b[0], b[1] + dy]], "arc": arc}))
open(D + '/arcax.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/arcax.txt', '--save', D + '/arcax.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr); sys.exit(1)
s = open(D + '/arcax.ifc').read()
ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
axes = re.findall(r"IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION\(#6,'Axis','Curve2D',\(#(\d+)\)\)", s)
ORIG = []
for a in axes:
    ids = re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[int(a)])
    ORIG.append((ents[int(ids[0])], ents[int(ids[-1])]))
def fmt(v):
    v = v + 0.0
    return ('%.6f' % v).rstrip('0')
def norm(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0] ** 2 + v[1] ** 2); r = 1.0 / l
    return (v[0] * r, v[1] * r)
def perp(v): return (-v[1], v[0])
def add(a, b): return (a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1])
def sub(a, b): return (a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])
def mul(a, k): return (a[0] * k, a[1] * k)
def dot(a, b): return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]
def rot(v, ang):
    s, c = math.sin(ang), math.cos(ang)
    return (v[0] * c - v[1] * s, v[0] * s + v[1] * c)
def segs(radius, sweep):
    step = 2.0 * math.acos(1.0 - 1.0 / abs(radius))
    return max(1, math.ceil(abs(sweep) / step))
def run(hc, start, end, arc):
    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    chord = sub(end, start)
    c = math.sqrt(chord[0] ** 2 + chord[1] ** 2)
    d = norm(chord)
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    t = rot(d, -sweep / 2.0)
    if hc == 'C1':
        n = perp(t)
        centre = add(start, mul(n, R)) if sweep > 0 else sub(start, mul(n, R))
    elif hc == 'C2':
        m = add(start, mul(chord, 0.5))
        h = R * math.cos(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h)) if sweep > 0 else sub(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    elif hc == 'C3':
        m = mul(add(start, end), 0.5)
        h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    elif hc == 'C4':
        m = add(start, mul(chord, 0.5))
        h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
        centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    a0 = math.atan2(start[1] - centre[1], start[0] - centre[0])
    dd = (-math.sin(a0), math.cos(a0)) if sweep > 0 else (math.sin(a0), -math.cos(a0))
    nn = perp(dd)
    k = segs(R, sweep)
    p0 = add(centre, mul((math.cos(a0), math.sin(a0)), R))
    a1 = a0 + sweep
    p1 = add(centre, mul((math.cos(a1), math.sin(a1)), R))
    loc = lambda p: (dot(sub(p, start), dd), dot(sub(p, start), nn))
    l0, l1 = loc(p0), loc(p1)
    return ('(%s,%s)' % (fmt(l0[0]), fmt(l0[1])), '(%s,%s)' % (fmt(l1[0]), fmt(l1[1])))
for hc in ['C1', 'C2', 'C3', 'C4']:
    res = []
    for kk, (a, b, arc) in enumerate(walls):
        dy = 30000 * kk
        res.append(run(hc, (float(a[0]), float(a[1] + dy)), (float(b[0]), float(b[1] + dy)), arc))
    sc0 = sum(1 for x, y in zip(res, ORIG) if x[0] == y[0])
    sc1 = sum(1 for x, y in zip(res, ORIG) if x[1] == y[1])
    print(hc, 'first', sc0, 'last', sc1, '/', len(walls))
print('orig', ORIG)

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final message is returned to you as the tool result; it is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- A previously spawned agent cannot be continued from here; every Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    chord = sub(end, start)
    c = math.sqrt(chord[0] ** 2 + chord[1] ** 2)
    d = norm(chord)
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    if hc == 'C3':
        m = mul(add(start, end), 0.5)
    else:
        m = add(start, mul(chord, 0.5))
    h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
    centre = add(m, mul(perp(d), h))
    if rf == 'dist':
        v = sub(start, centre); R = math.sqrt(v[0]**2+v[1]**2)
    elif rf == 'hyp':
        R = math.hypot(c/2.0, h)
    a0 = math.atan2(start[1] - centre[1], start[0] - centre[0])
    dd = (-math.sin(a0), math.cos(a0)) if sweep > 0 else (math.sin(a0), -math.cos(a0))
    nn = perp(dd)
    k = segs(R, sweep)
    out=[]
    for i in range(k+1):
        ang = a0 + sweep * i / k
        p = add(centre, mul((math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)), R))
        l = (dot(sub(p, start), dd), dot(sub(p, start), nn))
        out.append('(%s,%s)' % (fmt(l[0]), fmt(l[1])))
    return out
for hc in ['C3','C4']:

        tot=ok=0
        for kk,(a,b,arc) in enumerate(walls):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Arc walls of many radii and sweeps: the original's segment counts, against the tolerance rule."""
import re, math, json, subprocess, sys
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
walls = []
for c in [50, 100, 200, 300, 500, 700, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 5000, 8000]:
    for arc in [3, 10, 20, 45, 60, 90, 120, 150, 179, 200, 270, 330]:
        walls.append((c, arc))
cmds = []
for k, (c, arc) in enumerate(walls):
    y = 20000 * k
    cmds.append('wall ' + json.dumps({"points": [[0, y], [c, y]], "arc": arc}))
open(D + '/arcsegs.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/arcsegs.txt', '--save', D + '/arcsegs.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr); sys.exit(1)
s = open(D + '/arcsegs.ifc').read()
ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
axes = re.findall(r"IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION\(#6,'Axis','Curve2D',\(#(\d+)\)\)", s)
ALL = [[ents[int(i)] for i in re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[int(a)])] for a in axes]
print('walls', len(ALL), len(walls))
def segs(radius, sweep):
    r = abs(radius)
    if r <= 0.5: return 1
    step = 2.0 * math.acos(1.0 - 1.0 / r)
    return max(1, math.ceil(abs(sweep) / step))
for k, (c, arc) in enumerate(walls):
    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    n = len(ALL[k]) - 1
    mine = segs(R, sweep)
    flag = '' if n == mine else '  <-- '
    print('c=%5d arc=%4d R=%10.2f orig=%4d mine=%4d sweep/n=%.4f deg %s' % (c, arc, R, n, mine, arc / n, flag))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Arc walls of many radii and sweeps: the original's segment counts, against the tolerance rule."""
import re, math, json, subprocess, sys
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
walls = []
for c in [50, 100, 200, 300, 500, 700, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 5000, 8000]:
    for arc in [3, 10, 20, 45, 60, 90, 120, 150, 179, 200, 270, 330]:
        walls.append((c, arc))
cmds = []
for k, (c, arc) in enumerate(walls):
    y = 20000 * k
    cmds.append('wall ' + json.dumps({"points": [[0, y], [c, y]], "arc": arc}))
open(D + '/arcsegs.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/arcsegs.txt', '--save', D + '/arcsegs.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr); sys.exit(1)
s = open(D + '/arcsegs.ifc').read()
ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
axes = re.findall(r"IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION\(#6,'Axis','Curve2D',\(#(\d+)\)\)", s)
ALL = [[ents[int(i)] for i in re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[int(a)])] for a in axes]
print('walls', len(ALL), len(walls))
def segs(radius, sweep):
    r = abs(radius)
    if r <= 0.5: return 1
    step = 2.0 * math.acos(1.0 - 1.0 / r)
    return max(1, math.ceil(abs(sweep) / step))
for k, (c, arc) in enumerate(walls):
    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    n = len(ALL[k]) - 1
    mine = segs(R, sweep)
    flag = '' if n == mine else '  <-- '
    print('c=%5d arc=%4d R=%10.2f orig=%4d mine=%4d sweep/n=%.4f deg %s' % (c, arc, R, n, mine, arc / n, flag))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fit the original's arc segment counts (from arcsegs.ifc and arcax2.ifc) with candidate rules."""
import re, math, json, sys
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
cases = []  # (start, end, arc, orig_n)
def load(txt, ifc):
    s = open(ifc).read()
    ents = {int(m.group(1)): m.group(2) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=\w+\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
    axes = re.findall(r"IFCSHAPEREPRESENTATION\(#6,'Axis','Curve2D',\(#(\d+)\)\)", s)
    ns = [len(re.findall(r'#(\d+)', ents[int(a)])) - 1 for a in axes]
    ws = []
    for line in open(txt):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('wall '): continue
        e = json.loads(line[5:])
        ws.append((tuple(map(float, e['points'][0])), tuple(map(float, e['points'][1])), float(e['arc'])))
    assert len(ws) == len(ns), (len(ws), len(ns))
    for w, n in zip(ws, ns):
        cases.append((w[0], w[1], w[2], n))
for name in sys.argv[1:] or ['arcsegs', 'arcax2', 'arcax']:
    load(D + '/' + name + '.txt', D + '/' + name + '.ifc')
print('cases', len(cases))
def geom(start, end, arc):
    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    cx, cy = end[0] - start[0], end[1] - start[1]
    c = math.sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy)
    r = 1.0 / c
    d = (cx * r, cy * r)
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    m = ((start[0] + end[0]) * 0.5, (start[1] + end[1]) * 0.5)
    h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
    centre = (m[0] - d[1] * h, m[1] + d[0] * h)
    a0 = math.atan2(start[1] - centre[1], start[0] - centre[0])
    a1 = math.atan2(end[1] - centre[1], end[0] - centre[0])
    sw = a1 - a0
    if sweep > 0:
        while sw <= 0: sw += 2 * math.pi
    else:
        while sw >= 0: sw -= 2 * math.pi
    return sweep, R, sw, a0, a1
def tolsteps(R, sw):
    if R <= 0.5: return 1
    step = 2.0 * math.acos(1.0 - 1.0 / R)
    return math.ceil(abs(sw) / step)
rules = {
    'radians/5deg': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sweep), math.ceil(abs(sweep) / math.radians(5.0))),
    'deg/5': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sweep), math.ceil(abs(arc) / 5.0)),
    'tau/72': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sweep), math.ceil(abs(sweep) / (2 * math.pi / 72.0))),
    'pi/36': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sweep), math.ceil(abs(sweep) / (math.pi / 36.0))),
    'geom sw radians5': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sw), math.ceil(abs(sw) / math.radians(5.0))),
    'geom sw pi/36': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sw), math.ceil(abs(sw) / (math.pi / 36.0))),
    'geom sw deg': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sw), math.ceil(abs(math.degrees(sw)) / 5.0)),
    'sweep deg': lambda sweep, R, sw, arc: max(1, tolsteps(R, sweep), math.ceil(abs(math.degrees(sweep)) / 5.0)),
}
for name, rule in rules.items():
    bad = []
    for (st, en, arc, n) in cases:
        sweep, R, sw, a0, a1 = geom(st, en, arc)
        got = rule(sweep, R, sw, arc)
        if got != n:
            bad.append((round(en[0] - st[0], 3), round(en[1] - st[1], 3), arc, n, got))
    print('%-20s bad %3d  %s' % (name, len(bad), bad[:8]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build cases with the original and compare my export.

usage:
  case.py build NAME            # cases/NAME.txt (a script) -> cases/NAME.bimcraft, cases/NAME.ifc (original)
  case.py cmp NAME [-n LINES]   # convert cases/NAME.bimcraft with mine and the original; diff normalised
  case.py all                   # cmp every case, print SAME/DIFF per case
"""
import os, re, subprocess, sys, difflib, glob, tempfile, shutil
ORIG = '/workspace/executable'
MINE = os.environ.get('MINE', '/workspace/.claude/worktrees/agent-a7aa74e0622ce519f/target/release/bimcraft-cli')
D = os.environ.get('CASES', '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/cases')

def norm(s):
    s = re.sub(r"'\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d'", "'<TIMESTAMP>'", s)
    gm = {}
    def grep(mo):
        g = mo.group(1)
        if g not in gm: gm[g] = 'GID-%d' % (len(gm)+1)
        return "('" + gm[g] + "'"
    s = re.sub(r"\('([0-9A-Za-z_$]{22})'", grep, s)
    return s

def build(name):
    txt = os.path.join(D, name + '.txt')
    bim = os.path.join(D, name + '.bimcraft')
    ifc = os.path.join(D, name + '.ifc')
    args = [ORIG, 'run']
    if open(txt).read().strip():
        args += ['--script', txt]
    args += ['--save', bim, '--save', ifc]
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print('BUILD FAILED', name, p.stderr.strip()[:2000])
        return False
    return True

def export(exe, bim):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='ifcx')
    out = os.path.join(d, 'out.ifc')
    p = subprocess.run([exe, 'convert', bim, out], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    s = open(out, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read() if os.path.exists(out) else ''
    shutil.rmtree(d)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr, s

def cmp(name, n=40, quiet=False):
    bim = os.path.join(D, name + '.bimcraft')
    if not os.path.exists(bim):
        if not build(name): return False
    a = export(ORIG, bim)
    b = export(MINE, bim)
    x = norm(a[3]).splitlines()
    y = norm(b[3]).splitlines()
    ok = x == y and a[0] == b[0]
    if not ok and not quiet:
        if a[0] != b[0] or a[2] != b[2]:
            print('exit/stderr: orig', a[0], a[2].strip()[:300], '| mine', b[0], b[2].strip()[:300])
        for l in list(difflib.unified_diff(x, y, 'orig', 'mine', lineterm='', n=1))[:n]:
            print(l[:400])
    return ok

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Free arc walls: which way of computing the centre, the offset arcs' points and the local frame
reproduces every axis and body-profile point the original writes (signs of zero included).

usage: arcvar.py CASE...   (cases/CASE.txt scripts of free walls, cases/CASE.ifc the original's)
"""
import re, math, json, sys, itertools
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/cases'

def fmt(v):
    v = v + 0.0
    t = ('%.6f' % v).rstrip('0')
    return t
def P(x, y):
    return '(%s,%s)' % (fmt(x), fmt(y))

def load(name):
    s = open(D + '/' + name + '.ifc').read()
    ents = {int(m.group(1)): (m.group(2), m.group(3)) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=(\w+)\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
    def refs(t): return [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'#(\d+)', t)]
    walls = [e for e in sorted(ents) if ents[e][0] == 'IFCWALL']
    out = []
    for w in walls:
        args = ents[w][1]
        rr = refs(args)
        place, shape = rr[0], rr[1]
        reps = refs(ents[shape][1])
        axis = body = None
        for r in reps:
            t = ents[r][1]
            if "'Axis'" in t:
                axis = [ents[x][1] for x in refs(ents[refs(t)[-1]][1])]
            elif "'Body'" in t and 'SweptSolid' in t:
                solid = refs(t)[-1]
                prof = refs(ents[solid][1])[0]
                poly = refs(ents[prof][1])[-1]
                body = [ents[x][1] for x in refs(ents[poly][1])]
        out.append((axis, body))
    ws = []
    for line in open(D + '/' + name + '.txt'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('wall '): continue
        e = json.loads(line[5:])
        ws.append((tuple(map(float, e['points'][0])), tuple(map(float, e['points'][1])), float(e.get('arc', 0))))
    assert len(ws) == len(out)
    return list(zip(ws, out))

def segs(radius, sweep):
    r = abs(radius)
    turn = (r * abs(sweep)) / r
    by_turn = math.ceil(turn / math.radians(5.0))
    by_sag = 1 if r <= 0.5 else math.ceil(abs(sweep) / (2.0 * math.acos(1.0 - 1.0 / r)))
    return max(by_turn, by_sag, 1)

def sim(w, var, half=100.0):
    (sx, sy), (ex, ey), arc = w
    cen, offm, frame, angm = var
    sweep = math.radians(arc)
    cx, cy = ex - sx, ey - sy
    c = math.sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy)
    rc = 1.0 / c
    dx, dy = cx * rc, cy * rc
    R = c / (2.0 * math.sin(abs(sweep) / 2.0))
    h = (c / 2.0) / math.tan(sweep / 2.0)
    if cen == 'mid':
        mx, my = (sx + ex) * 0.5, (sy + ey) * 0.5
    elif cen == 'lerp':
        mx, my = sx + cx * 0.5, sy + cy * 0.5
    elif cen == 'half':
        mx, my = sx * 0.5 + ex * 0.5, sy * 0.5 + ey * 0.5
    ox, oy = mx + (-dy) * h, my + dx * h
    a0 = math.atan2(sy - oy, sx - ox)
    if sweep > 0:
        tx, ty = -math.sin(a0), math.cos(a0)
    else:
        tx, ty = math.sin(a0), -math.cos(a0)
    nx, ny = -ty, tx
    k = segs(R, sweep)
    def pt(i, off):
        if angm == 'mul':
            a = a0 + sweep * i / k
        elif angm == 'step':
            a = a0 + (sweep / k) * i
        elif angm == 'frac':
            a = a0 + sweep * (i / k)
        ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        if offm == 'radius':
            r = R - off if sweep > 0 else R + off
            px, py = ox + ca * r, oy + sa * r
        elif offm == 'radius2':
            r = R - off if sweep > 0 else R + off
            px, py = ox + r * ca, oy + r * sa
        elif offm == 'normal':
            # the axis point moved along the left normal
            ax, ay = ox + ca * R, oy + sa * R
            lx, ly = (-ca, -sa) if sweep > 0 else (ca, sa)
            px, py = ax + lx * off, ay + ly * off
        return px, py
    def loc(px, py):
        vx, vy = px - sx, py - sy
        if frame == 'dot':
            return vx * tx + vy * ty, vx * nx + vy * ny
        elif frame == 'dot2':
            return tx * vx + ty * vy, nx * vx + ny * vy
        elif frame == 'ang':
            th = math.atan2(ty, tx)
            cs, sn = math.cos(-th), math.sin(-th)
            return vx * cs - vy * sn, vx * sn + vy * cs
    axis = [P(*loc(*pt(i, 0.0))) for i in range(k + 1)]
    lp = [loc(*pt(i, half)) for i in range(k + 1)]
    rp = [loc(*pt(i, -half)) for i in range(k + 1)]
    ring = [rp[0], lp[0]] + lp[1:k] + [lp[k], rp[k]] + rp[1:k][::-1]
    body = [P(*q) for q in ring]
    return axis, body

data = []
for name in sys.argv[1:]:
    data += load(name)
print('walls', len(data))
dims = [['mid', 'lerp', 'half'], ['radius', 'radius2', 'normal'], ['dot', 'dot2', 'ang'], ['mul', 'step', 'frac']]
for var in itertools.product(*dims):
    bad_ax = bad_b = 0
    ex = []
    for w, (axis, body) in data:
        a, b = sim(w, var)
        if axis != a:
            bad_ax += 1
            ex.append(('ax', [(i, x, y) for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a, axis)) if x != y][:2]))
        if body[:len(b)] != b:
            bad_b += 1
            ex.append(('body', [(i, x, y) for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(b, body)) if x != y][:2]))
    print(var, 'axis bad', bad_ax, 'body bad', bad_b, ex[:3])

    L = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy); r = 1.0/L

def cands(e, p):
    th = math.radians(e['slope']); z0 = e.get('offset', 0.0)
    tail, head = e['arrow']
    u = norm(head[0]-tail[0], head[1]-tail[1])
    tn = math.tan(th); sn = math.sin(th); cs = math.cos(th)
    L = math.sqrt((head[0]-tail[0])**2 + (head[1]-tail[1])**2)
    out = {}
    out['tail'] = z0 + ((p[0]-tail[0])*u[0] + (p[1]-tail[1])*u[1]) * tn
    zh = z0 + L*tn
    out['head'] = zh + ((p[0]-head[0])*u[0] + (p[1]-head[1])*u[1]) * tn
    # plane through tail with normal, d form
    for nm, n in [('n', (-u[0]*sn, -u[1]*sn, cs))]:
        ln = math.sqrt(n[0]*n[0]+n[1]*n[1]+n[2]*n[2]); r = 1/ln
        nn = (n[0]*r, n[1]*r, n[2]*r)
        for nname, N in [(nm, n), (nm+'u', nn)]:
            for refn, ref in [('T', (tail[0], tail[1], z0)), ('H', (head[0], head[1], zh))]:
                d = N[0]*ref[0] + N[1]*ref[1] + N[2]*ref[2]
                out['plane'+nname+refn] = (d - N[0]*p[0] - N[1]*p[1]) / N[2]
                out['plane2'+nname+refn] = (d - (N[0]*p[0] + N[1]*p[1])) / N[2]
                out['plane3'+nname+refn] = -(N[0]*p[0] + N[1]*p[1] - d) / N[2]
    # absolute linear form
    a = tn*u[0]; b = tn*u[1]
    c = z0 - (a*tail[0] + b*tail[1])
    out['lin'] = a*p[0] + b*p[1] + c
    out['lin2'] = c + a*p[0] + b*p[1]
    out['lin3'] = (a*p[0] + b*p[1]) + c
    c2 = z0 - tn*(u[0]*tail[0] + u[1]*tail[1])
    out['lin4'] = tn*(u[0]*p[0] + u[1]*p[1]) + c2
    out['lin5'] = z0 + tn*(u[0]*p[0] + u[1]*p[1]) - tn*(u[0]*tail[0] + u[1]*tail[1])
    out['lin6'] = z0 + (tn*(u[0]*p[0] + u[1]*p[1]) - tn*(u[0]*tail[0] + u[1]*tail[1]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Search top-height formulas of sloped floors against slprobe.json (signs of zero included)."""
import json, math, sys
data = json.load(open(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe/slprobe.json'))
def fmt(x):
    s = '%.6f' % (x + 0.0)
    return s.rstrip('0')
def norm2(dx, dy):
    L = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); r = 1.0 / L
    return dx * r, dy * r
def norm3(x, y, z):
    L = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z); r = 1.0 / L
    return x * r, y * r, z * r
def cross(a, b):
    return (a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0])
def dot3(a, b):
    return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]

def cands(f):
    s = math.radians(f['slope'])
    z0 = float(f.get('offset', 0.0))
    (tx, ty), (hx, hy) = f['arrow']
    tx, ty, hx, hy = float(tx), float(ty), float(hx), float(hy)
    u = norm2(hx - tx, hy - ty)
    L = math.sqrt((hx - tx) ** 2 + (hy - ty) ** 2)
    tn, sn, cs = math.tan(s), math.sin(s), math.cos(s)
    C = {}
    C['diff'] = lambda x, y: z0 + ((x - tx) * u[0] + (y - ty) * u[1]) * tn
    # normals
    normals = {
        'n_sc': (-u[0] * sn, -u[1] * sn, cs),
        'n_t1': (-u[0] * tn, -u[1] * tn, 1.0),
        'n_t1u': norm3(-u[0] * tn, -u[1] * tn, 1.0),
    }
    a3 = (u[0], u[1], tn)
    p3 = (-u[1], u[0], 0.0)
    normals['n_cross'] = cross(p3, a3)
    normals['n_crossu'] = norm3(*cross(p3, a3))
    a3b = (u[0] * cs, u[1] * cs, sn)
    normals['n_cross_cs'] = cross(p3, a3b)
    normals['n_cross_csu'] = norm3(*cross(p3, a3b))
    a3c = (hx - tx, hy - ty, L * tn)
    normals['n_cross_raw'] = cross((-(hy - ty), hx - tx, 0.0), a3c)
    normals['n_cross_rawu'] = norm3(*normals['n_cross_raw'])
    refs = {'T': (tx, ty, z0), 'H': (hx, hy, z0 + L * tn)}
    for nn, n in normals.items():
        if abs(n[2]) < 1e-12: continue
        for rn, r in refs.items():
            d = dot3(n, r)

        floors.append((fam, x, y, L, W, s, A))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Residue forms f(x, s) for the top at a horizontal arrow's tail corner, against the original's
signs (slprobe2.json families E2/E6 and slprobe.json horizontal-arrow floors)."""
import json, math
def fmt(x):
    s = '%.6f' % (x + 0.0)
    return s.rstrip('0')
obs = []  # (x, slope, sign string)
for r in json.load(open('/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe/slprobe2.json')):
    fam, x, y, L, W, s, A = r['f']
    obs.append((float(x), float(s), r['top'][0].split(',')[2], float(A), float(y)))
for it in json.load(open('/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe/slprobe.json')):
    f = it['floor']
    (tx, ty), (hx, hy) = f['arrow']
    if ty == hy and hx > tx and f['boundary'][0][0] == tx and not f.get('offset'):
        obs.append((float(tx), float(f['slope']), it['top'][0].split(',')[2], float(hx - tx), float(f['boundary'][0][1])))
print('observations', len(obs))
def n3(x, y, z):
    l = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z); r = 1.0 / l
    return (x * r, y * r, z * r)
def forms(x, s, A, y):
    r = math.radians(s)
    tn, sn, cs = math.tan(r), math.sin(r), math.cos(r)
    tx = x
    F = {}
    F['tan-sincos'] = x * tn - tx * (sn / cs)
    F['sincos-tan'] = x * (sn / cs) - tx * tn
    F['tan-sin/cos'] = x * tn - (tx * sn) / cs
    F['sin/cos-tan'] = (x * sn) / cs - tx * tn
    for nm, n in [('sc', (-sn, 0.0, cs)), ('t1', (-tn, 0.0, 1.0)), ('t1u', n3(-tn, 0.0, 1.0)), ('sc_u', n3(-sn, 0.0, cs)),
                  ('sc+', (sn, 0.0, -cs)), ('t1u+', n3(tn, 0.0, -1.0)), ('cr', (-tn * A, 0.0, A)), ('cru', n3(-tn * A, 0.0, A)),
                  ('cs_cr', n3(-sn, -0.0, cs))]:
        nx, ny, nz = n
        d = nx * tx + ny * 0.0 + nz * 0.0
        kx = -nx / nz
        c = d / nz
        F['slope-int ' + nm] = kx * x + c
        F['slope-int2 ' + nm] = c + kx * x
        F['slope-int3 ' + nm] = c - (nx / nz) * x
        F['slope-int4 ' + nm] = -(nx / nz) * x + d / nz
        F['divd ' + nm] = (d - nx * x) / nz
        F['divd2 ' + nm] = d / nz - nx * x / nz
        F['divd3 ' + nm] = d / nz - (nx * x) / nz
        F['divd4 ' + nm] = d / nz - nx / nz * x
        F['mulrec ' + nm] = (d - nx * x) * (1.0 / nz)
        F['mulrec2 ' + nm] = d * (1.0 / nz) - nx * x * (1.0 / nz)
    return F
stats = {}
for (x, s, want, A, y) in obs:
    for name, z in forms(x, s, A, y).items():
        ok = fmt(z) == want
        st = stats.setdefault(name, [0, 0])
        st[0 if ok else 1] += 1
for k, v in sorted(stats.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][1])[:20]:
    print('%-24s ok %3d bad %3d' % (k, v[0], v[1]))

"""Check sloped floors' bottoms against the underside-plane form."""
import json, math
def fmt(x):
    s = '%.6f' % (x + 0.0)
    return s.rstrip('0')
def norm2(x, y):
    l = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y); r = 1.0 / l
    return (x * r, y * r)
T = 200.0
bad = tot = 0

    s = math.radians(f['slope'])
    tn, cs = math.tan(s), math.cos(s)
    u = norm2(hx - tx, hy - ty)
    tv = T / cs
    z0 = float(f.get('offset', 0.0))
    lev = 0.0
    nx, ny = -u[0] * tn, -u[1] * tn
    dd = nx * tx + ny * ty + lev + (z0 - tv)

"""Print each slab's Brep pieces (bottom rings in plan) from an IFC file.
usage: pieces.py FILE.ifc [SLAB_INDEX...]"""
import re, sys
s = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
want = [int(x) for x in sys.argv[2:]]
ents = {int(m.group(1)): (m.group(2), m.group(3)) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=(\w+)\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
def refs(t): return [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'#(\d+)', t)]
slabs = [e for e in sorted(ents) if ents[e][0] in ('IFCSLAB', 'IFCROOF', 'IFCCOVERING')]
for k, sl in enumerate(slabs):
    if want and k not in want:
        continue
    shape = refs(ents[sl][1])[1]
    print('slab', k, ents[sl][1][:60])
    for rep in refs(ents[shape][1]):
        for item in refs(ents[rep][1])[1:]:
            if ents[item][0] != 'IFCFACETEDBREP':
                print('   ', ents[item][0])
                continue
            shell = refs(ents[item][1])[0]
            faces = refs(ents[shell][1])
            bound = refs(ents[faces[0]][1])[0]
            loop = refs(ents[bound][1])[0]
            pts = [ents[x][1].strip('()') for x in refs(ents[loop][1])]
            pts = [','.join(p.split(',')[:2]) for p in pts][::-1]
            print('   ', ' '.join('(%s)' % p for p in pts))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The first edge event of a quad's straight skeleton, in high precision and in several float
ways, to compare with the original's written ridge points."""
import json, sys, math
from decimal import Decimal as D, getcontext
getcontext().prec = 60
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
idx = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0
b = [tuple(map(float, p)) for p in d[idx]['roof']['boundary']]
print('pieces', d[idx]['pieces'])
n = len(b)
def hp():
    P = [(D(x), D(y)) for x, y in b]
    E = []
    for i in range(n):
        a, c = P[i], P[(i + 1) % n]
        ex, ey = c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]
        l = (ex * ex + ey * ey).sqrt()
        dx, dy = ex / l, ey / l
        E.append((a, (dx, dy), (-dy, dx)))
    V = []
    for i in range(n):
        e1, e2 = E[(i - 1) % n], E[i]
        n1, n2 = e1[2], e2[2]
        det = n1[0] * n2[1] - n1[1] * n2[0]
        vx = (1 * n2[1] - 1 * n1[1]) / det
        vy = (n1[0] * 1 - n2[0] * 1) / det
        V.append((vx, vy))
    res = []
    for i in range(n):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        dd = E[i][1]
        rate = (V[j][0] - V[i][0]) * dd[0] + (V[j][1] - V[i][1]) * dd[1]
        if rate < 0:
            ln = (P[j][0] - P[i][0]) * dd[0] + (P[j][1] - P[i][1]) * dd[1]
            t = ln / (-rate)
            res.append((t, i, (P[i][0] + V[i][0] * t, P[i][1] + V[i][1] * t), (P[j][0] + V[j][0] * t, P[j][1] + V[j][1] * t)))
    res.sort()
    return res
for t, i, x, y in hp()[:2]:
    print('hp edge', i, 't', t, 'pt from i', [str(round(v, 9)) for v in x], 'from j', [str(round(v, 9)) for v in y])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""After a near-rectangle's first edge event, the fast vertex's events: where each puts the
second node, against the original's."""
import json, math, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
def fmt(x):
    s = '%.6f' % (x + 0.0)
    return s.rstrip('0')
def norm(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0] ** 2 + v[1] ** 2); r = 1.0 / l
    return (v[0] * r, v[1] * r)
def vel(n1, n2):
    det = n1[0] * n2[1] - n1[1] * n2[0]
    return ((1.0 * n2[1] - 1.0 * n1[1]) / det, (n1[0] * 1.0 - n2[0] * 1.0) / det)
def dot(a, b): return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]
def sub(a, b): return (a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])
score = {}
show = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 0
for idx, item in enumerate(d):
    b = [tuple(map(float, p)) for p in item['roof']['boundary']]
    n = len(b)
    E = []
    for i in range(n):
        a, c = b[i], b[(i + 1) % n]
        dd = norm((c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]))
        E.append((a, dd, (-dd[1], dd[0])))
    V = [vel(E[(i - 1) % n][2], E[i][2]) for i in range(n)]
    ev = []
    for i in range(n):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        dd = E[i][1]
        rate = (V[j][0] - V[i][0]) * dd[0] + (V[j][1] - V[i][1]) * dd[1]
        if rate < 0:
            ln = (b[j][0] - b[i][0]) * dd[0] + (b[j][1] - b[i][1]) * dd[1]
            ev.append((ln / (-rate), i, j))
    ev.sort()
    if len(ev) < 2:
        continue
    tA, iA, jA = ev[0]
    at = lambda p, v, t0, t: (p[0] + v[0] * (t - t0), p[1] + v[1] * (t - t0))
    A = at(b[iA], V[iA], 0.0, tA)
    # the new vertex between edge iA-1 (incoming of iA) and edge jA (outgoing of jA)
    el = (iA - 1) % n
    er = jA
    VN = vel(E[el][2], E[er][2])
    pv = (iA - 1) % n  # vertex before iA
    nv = (jA + 1) % n
    # events: edge el (pv -> N), edge er (N -> nv), edge between nv and pv
    res = {}
    # pv -> N along edge el
    dd = E[el][1]
    rate = dot(sub(VN, V[pv]), dd)
    ln = dot(sub(A, at(b[pv], V[pv], 0.0, tA)), dd)
    t1 = tA + ln / (-rate)
    res['el_pv'] = at(b[pv], V[pv], 0.0, t1)
    res['el_N'] = at(A, VN, tA, t1)
    dd = E[er][1]
    rate = dot(sub(V[nv], VN), dd)
    ln = dot(sub(at(b[nv], V[nv], 0.0, tA), A), dd)
    t2 = tA + ln / (-rate)
    res['er_N'] = at(A, VN, tA, t2)
    res['er_nv'] = at(b[nv], V[nv], 0.0, t2)
    tB, iB, jB = ev[1]
    res['B_i'] = at(b[iB], V[iB], 0.0, tB)
    res['B_j'] = at(b[jB], V[jB], 0.0, tB)
    pts = set()
    for pc in item['pieces']:
        for q in pc[2:]:
            x, y, z = q.split(',')
            pts.add((x, y))
    if idx == show:
        print('A', A, 'VN', VN, 't1', t1, 't2', t2, 'tB', tB)
        for k, p in res.items():
            print('  ', k, '(%.9f, %.9f)' % p)
        print('  orig', pts)
    for k, p in res.items():
        key = (fmt(p[0]), fmt(p[1]))
        st = score.setdefault(k, [0, 0])
        st[0 if key in pts else 1] += 1
print(score)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounds on the original's second ridge node of near-rectangles: from its written x, y and its
heights on the faces round it (each a distance to an edge's line times the slope's tangent)."""
import json, math, sys
from decimal import Decimal as Dm, getcontext
getcontext().prec = 50
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
def fmt(x):
    s = '%.6f' % (x + 0.0)
    return s.rstrip('0')
for idx, item in enumerate(d):
    r = item['roof']
    b = [tuple(map(float, p)) for p in r['boundary']]
    n = len(b)
    tn = math.tan(math.radians(r['slope']))
    # exact lines
    P = [(Dm(x), Dm(y)) for x, y in b]
    L = []
    for i in range(n):
        a, c = P[i], P[(i + 1) % n]
        ex, ey = c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]
        l = (ex * ex + ey * ey).sqrt()
        nx, ny = -ey / l, ex / l
        L.append((nx, ny, -(nx * a[0] + ny * a[1])))
    def eq3(i):
        tri = [L[(i - 1) % n], L[i], L[(i + 1) % n]]
        (a1, b1, c1), (a2, b2, c2), (a3, b3, c3) = tri
        A11, A12, B1 = a1 - a2, b1 - b2, c2 - c1
        A21, A22, B2 = a2 - a3, b2 - b3, c3 - c2
        det = A11 * A22 - A12 * A21
        x = (B1 * A22 - A12 * B2) / det
        y = (A11 * B2 - B1 * A21) / det
        return (x, y, a1 * x + b1 * y + c1)
    ex = sorted([eq3(i) + (i,) for i in range(n)], key=lambda q: q[2])[:2]
    pts = {}
    for k, pc in enumerate(item['pieces']):
        for q in pc[2:]:
            x, y, z = q.split(',')
            pts.setdefault((x, y), []).append((k, z))
    exs = [(fmt(float(e[0])), fmt(float(e[1]))) for e in ex]
    if set(exs) != set(pts.keys()):
        print('roof', idx, 'slope', r['slope'], r['level'])
        for e in ex:
            print('   exact edge %d (%.9f, %.9f) t=%.9f' % (e[3], e[0], e[1], e[2]))
        for kk, v in pts.items():
            print('   orig', kk, v)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Make a normalised expected project (GUID-n, <UID> placeholders) loadable.
usage: fixbim.py IN OUT"""
import re, sys
s = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
CH = '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_$'
def gid(n):
    out = []
    x = n * 2654435761 + 12345
    for i in range(22):
        out.append(CH[x % 64] if i else CH[x % 4])
        x //= 64 if i else 4
        x += n * 7 + i
    return ''.join(out)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Rotated hip roofs on Level 1, offset 0, slope 30: the original's eave-corner signs.
usage: roofprobe2.py SEED N OUT.json"""
import json, math, random, re, subprocess, sys
seed, N, out = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
random.seed(seed)
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe'
roofs = []
for k in range(N):
    cx, cy = 30000.0 * (k % 10) + random.uniform(-500, 500), 30000.0 * (k // 10) + random.uniform(-500, 500)
    w, h = random.uniform(4000, 12000), random.uniform(3000, 8000)
    ang = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
    c, s = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
    pts = []
    for (u, v) in [(-w / 2, -h / 2), (w / 2, -h / 2), (w / 2, h / 2), (-w / 2, h / 2)]:
        pts.append([round(cx + u * c - v * s, 3), round(cy + u * s + v * c, 3)])
    roofs.append({"boundary": pts, "slope": 30, "level": "Level 1"})
cmds = ['roof ' + json.dumps(r) for r in roofs]
open(D + '/roofprobe2.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds) + '\n')
p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/roofprobe2.txt', '--save', D + '/roofprobe2.ifc'], capture_output=True, text=True)
if p.returncode:
    print(p.stderr[:2000]); sys.exit(1)
s = open(D + '/roofprobe2.ifc').read()
ents = {int(m.group(1)): (m.group(2), m.group(3)) for m in re.finditer(r'^#(\d+)=(\w+)\((.*)\);$', s, re.M)}
def refs(t): return [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'#(\d+)', t)]
rf = [e for e in sorted(ents) if ents[e][0] == 'IFCROOF']
res = []
for r, e in zip(roofs, rf):
    shape = refs(ents[e][1])[1]
    pieces = []
    for rep in refs(ents[shape][1]):
        for item in refs(ents[rep][1])[1:]:
            if ents[item][0] != 'IFCFACETEDBREP':
                continue
            shell = refs(ents[item][1])[0]
            faces = refs(ents[shell][1])
            bound = refs(ents[faces[0]][1])[0]
            loop = refs(ents[bound][1])[0]
            pts = [ents[x][1].strip('()') for x in refs(ents[loop][1])][::-1]
            # the top face too
            bound = refs(ents[faces[1]][1])[0]
            loop = refs(ents[bound][1])[0]
            top = [ents[x][1].strip('()') for x in refs(ents[loop][1])]
            pieces.append({'bottom': pts, 'top': top})
    res.append({'roof': r, 'pieces': pieces})
json.dump(res, open(out, 'w'))
print('roofs', len(res))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Level 1 rotated hip roofs: formula families for the eave corners' underside heights."""
import json, math, sys
def fmt(x):
    s = '%.6f' % (x + 0.0)
    return s.rstrip('0')
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
T = 300.0
stats = {}
for item in d:
    r = item['roof']
    lev, base = 0.0, 0.0
    s = math.radians(r['slope'])
    tn, cs, sn = math.tan(s), math.cos(s), math.sin(s)
    tv = T / cs
    b = [tuple(map(float, p)) for p in r['boundary']]
    n = len(b)
    for k, pc in enumerate(item['pieces'][:n]):
        r0, r1 = b[k], b[(k + 1) % n]
        ex, ey = r1[0] - r0[0], r1[1] - r0[1]
        L = math.sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey)
        dvec = (ex * (1.0 / L), ey * (1.0 / L))
        nrm = (-dvec[1], dvec[0])
        for sgn in [1, -1]:
            nx, ny = -sgn * nrm[0] * tn, -sgn * nrm[1] * tn
            S = lambda p: nx * p[0] + ny * p[1]
            S0 = S(r0)
            V = {}
            if sgn == 1:
                V['F1'] = lambda p: (S0 + (lev + base) - S(p)) - lev
                V['F2 (S0+tv)-S-tv'] = lambda p: ((S0 + tv) - S(p)) - tv
                V['F3 (S0-tv)-S+tv'] = lambda p: ((S0 - tv) - S(p)) + tv
                V['F4 S0+lev+(b-tv)'] = lambda p: ((S0 + lev + (base - tv)) - S(p)) - lev + tv
                V['F4b'] = lambda p: (((S0 + lev + (base - tv)) - S(p)) - lev) + tv
                V['F5 floorlike top'] = lambda p: ((S0 + lev + ((base + tv) - tv)) - S(p)) - lev
                V['F6 S0+lev+(b+tv) -tv'] = lambda p: (((S0 + lev + (base + tv)) - S(p)) - lev) - tv
            else:
                V['G1 S-S0'] = lambda p: (S(p) - S0) + base
                V['G2'] = lambda p: ((S(p) + tv) - S0) - tv
                V['G3'] = lambda p: ((S(p) - S0) + tv) - tv
                V['G4'] = lambda p: (S(p) + (base - S0))
                V['G5'] = lambda p: (S(p) - (S0 - base))
            for name, f in V.items():
                for q, want in [(r0, pc['bottom'][0]), (r1, pc['bottom'][1])]:
                    ok = fmt(f(q)) == want.split(',')[2]
                    st = stats.setdefault(name, [0, 0])
                    st[0 if ok else 1] += 1
for k, v in sorted(stats.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][1]):
    print('%-24s ok %4d bad %4d' % (k, v[0], v[1]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""How the language and the phase settings decide the project's BIMCraft_Phasing set."""
import json, subprocess, os, re
D = '/tmp/ifc-export-agent/probe/lang'
cases = {
    'en_pt_filter': ['language {"code": "pt"}', 'phase_filter {"name": "X", "new": "overridden"}'],
    'pt_phase': ['new {"language": "pt"}', 'phase {"name": "Demolição", "before": "Nova construção"}'],
    'pt_en': ['new {"language": "pt"}', 'language {"code": "en"}'],
    'pt_en_pt': ['new {"language": "pt"}', 'language {"code": "en"}', 'language {"code": "pt"}'],
    'en_filter': ['phase_filter {"name": "X", "new": "overridden"}'],
    'en_filter_del': ['phase_filter {"name": "X", "new": "overridden"}', 'phase_filter {"name": "X", "delete": true}'],
    'pt_filter_del': ['new {"language": "pt"}', 'phase_filter {"name": "X", "new": "overridden"}', 'phase_filter {"name": "X", "delete": true}'],
    'de': ['new {"language": "de"}'],
    'de_es': ['new {"language": "de"}', 'language {"code": "es"}'],
    'en_de': ['language {"code": "de"}'],
    'pt_override': ['new {"language": "pt"}', 'phase {"overrides": {"new": {"cut": {"color": [0, 0, 200]}}}}'],
}
for name, cmds in cases.items():
    open(D + '/c.txt', 'w').write('\n'.join(cmds + ['wall {"points": [[0,0],[8000,0]]}']) + '\n')
    p = subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable', 'run', '--script', D + '/c.txt', '--save', D + '/c.ifc', '--save', D + '/c_%s.bimcraft' % name], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode:
        print(name, 'FAILED', p.stderr[:300]); continue
    s = open(D + '/c.ifc').read()
    props = re.findall(r"IFCPROPERTY(?:LISTVALUE|SINGLEVALUE)\('(Phases|Phase Filters|Phase Overrides|Design Option Sets)',\$,(.*?),\$\);", s)
    d = json.load(open(D + '/c_%s.bimcraft' % name))
    print(name, '| file phases', d.get('phases'), '| filters key', 'phase_filters' in d, '| IFC:', [(k, v[:160]) for k, v in props])
